description: This is a Java test class for the class 'PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory'. It contains unit tests verifying various parameter resolution methods, especially for string and placeholder parameters, in the context of a pipeline processing framework.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing 'PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory' methods related to parameter parsing and resolution logic within a pipeline framework.

methods.name: singleStringResolverAcceptsDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Tests that the resolver accepts parameters enclosed in double quotes and correctly extracts the string value.

methods.name: singleStringResolverAcceptsSingleQuotes
methods.description: Tests that the resolver accepts parameters enclosed in single quotes and correctly extracts the string value.

methods.name: singleResolverThrowsExceptionOnMultipleParameters
methods.description: Verifies that the resolver throws an exception when multiple parameters are supplied.

methods.name: singleResolverResolvesPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks that placeholders are resolved to their corresponding string values when resolution is successful.

methods.name: singleResolverAllowsWhitespaceInStrings
methods.description: Tests the resolver's ability to handle whitespace around string values.

methods.name: singleResolverAllowsWhitespaceBetweenParentheses
methods.description: Ensures the resolver accepts and correctly processes whitespace between parentheses.

methods.name: singlePlaceholderResolverReturnsPlaceholderIfNotResolvable
methods.description: Tests that the resolver returns an unresolved placeholder if resolution fails.

methods.name: singleStringResolverThrowsExceptionIfNotResolvable
methods.description: Verifies that the resolver throws an exception when a placeholder cannot be resolved.

methods.name: singleStringResolverDoesNotResolvePlaceholders
methods.description: Checks that the string-only resolver does not attempt to resolve placeholders and throws exceptions if placeholders are improperly used.

methods.name: emptyParameterResolverResolvesEmptyParentheses
methods.description: Tests that an empty set of parentheses is recognized as an empty parameter list.

methods.name: emptyParameterResolverFailsForNonEmptyParentheses
methods.description: Verifies that parentheses with content are not considered valid empty parameters.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverAcceptsThreeDoubleQuotedStringParameters
methods.description: Tests acceptance of three double-quoted string parameters.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverAcceptsMixOfDoubleQuotedAndSingleQuotedStringParameters
methods.description: Checks that mix of double and single quotes are accepted for string parameters.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverAcceptsMixOfDoubleQuotedAndSingleQuotedStringParametersAndPlaceholders
methods.description: Tests mixed parameters including placeholders, which are resolved accordingly.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverFailsIfLessParametersAreGiven
methods.description: Verifies that insufficient parameters cause an exception.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverFailsIfMoreParametersAreGiven
methods.description: Verifies that too many parameters cause an exception.
